name: Flying Tulip
author: Flying Tulip
description: Flying Tulip in the Omarchy bar: FT market price, 24h application fees and, for the wallets you set (shown in turn), health factor with liquidation alerts, PnL, rewards, points and ftPUT gain. Public API only.

barWidget.description: FT price, 24h app fees, wallet HF and PnL from the public api.flyingtulip.com.

schema.label: Wallet address (0x...)
schema.description: Single wallet (older setting). Use the wallet editor (right click) to track several.

schema.label: Seconds per wallet
schema.description: With several wallets, the bar shows the next one after this long. A wallet whose health factor is low stays shown.

schema.label: HF warning threshold
schema.description: Liquidation starts below 1.25. Warn notification at or below this HF.

schema.label: HF critical threshold
schema.description: Critical notification at or below this HF. Keep it above 1.25.

schema.label: FT price chain id
schema.description: Chain whose FT-ftUSD market mark is shown: 1 Ethereum or 146 Sonic.
